title: CPAs, accounting firms, and tax preparers
hypothesis: The live CPA recipe-B route can create an active credentialed-person candidate and, after generic gates, a callable contact. It cannot establish that the person owns a CPA business or that the contact is a direct owner handset without independent owner evidence and an explicit direct business-role link to that phone.
ownerSource: Implemented person-level CPA register mappings are Florida fl_cpa, Illinois il_idfpr:cpa, and Pennsylvania pa_pals:accountancy. They establish credential candidates, not business ownership. A future owner label requires independent owner/founder evidence matched to the same business.
phoneSource: The implemented recipe-B path obtains a contact only after its address/trace and generic verification stages. A trace-derived number is not a published business contact or direct owner handset absent explicit linked evidence.

workflow.label: Mapped CPA register
workflow.detail: Read the mapped FL, IL, or PA person-level CPA register; recipe A Maps delivery is forbidden for CPAs.

workflow.label: Active individual credential filter
workflow.detail: Keep active individual CPA rows in scope; hold inactive, expired, out-of-state, entity, non-CPA, or firm-only rows.

workflow.label: Credential out of scope
workflow.detail: Hold failed status, entity, firm-only, non-CPA, or unavailable-source rows.

workflow.label: Credentialed person candidate
workflow.detail: Treat a person-level CPA credential as a candidate, not proof of business ownership.

workflow.label: Current recipe-B address and trace path
workflow.detail: Use the configured home/address path; Florida skips parcel because the license file carries a street. This path does not prove a business contact.

workflow.label: Contact candidate
workflow.detail: Keep any trace-derived number distinct from published-business-contact and handset evidence.

workflow.label: Line and compliance gates
workflow.detail: Require mobile classification, reachability, DNC/TCPA clearance, suppression, duplicate, freshness, and timezone checks.

workflow.label: Contact gate hold
workflow.detail: Hold non-mobile, unreachable, DNC/TCPA, suppressed, duplicate, stale, or timezone-unresolved rows.

workflow.label: Independent owner and direct-contact evidence
workflow.detail: A future owner-labelled row needs supported owner/founder evidence for the matched business and an explicit direct business-role link to this phone.

workflow.label: Ownership unresolved
workflow.detail: Hold employee, staff, firm-only, multi-preparer, front-desk, conflicting, or unlinked evidence; do not infer handset ownership.

workflow.label: Future owner-confirmed delivery
workflow.detail: Deliver an owner-confirmed CPA contact only after all contact/compliance gates and the separate ownership/contact proof pass.

edges.label: current route returns a number candidate
any line or compliance gate fails

failures.risk: An active individual CPA credential is represented as proof that the person owns an accounting business.
failures.mitigation: Keep the credential as an owner candidate and require independent owner/founder evidence matched to the business.

failures.risk: A trace-derived mobile is represented as a published business line or direct owner handset.
failures.mitigation: Require explicit direct business-role linkage to the same phone before any owner label; retain trace provenance separately.

failures.risk: Florida AD firm rows are absent while AC individual rows proceed.
failures.mitigation: Report the individual-only source scope and add a verified firm-to-responsible-licensee join only after owner semantics are confirmed.

failures.risk: Generic recipe-B delivery occurs without the existing owner-evidence assessment.
failures.mitigation: Require a supported assessOwnerEvidence result before owner-labelled CPA delivery and hold unresolved evidence.

failures.risk: Generic mobile and compliance checks are treated as ownership verification.
failures.mitigation: Keep line, reachability, DNC/TCPA, suppression, duplicate, freshness, and timezone checks separate from ownership and handset proof.

iterations.hypothesis: The implemented Florida CPA adapter only admits eligible individual AC rows and holds inactive or firm rows before a person-level candidate is created.
iterations.test: Five-row local fixture/code audit on 2026-09-24 using tests/fixtures/registers/fl_cpa.json through flCpa. Command: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern='fl_cpa|il_idfpr' tests/lead-engine-registers.test.ts. No network, credential, provider, contact-data, or paid call ran.
iterations.observed: Three current active future-expiring AC rows were kept; one inactive AC row was held as secondary_status_inactive; one AD firm row was omitted. The focused fl_cpa and il_idfpr tests both passed. This measures adapter behavior only, not ownership, phones, reachability, DNC/TCPA, handsets, or delivery.
iterations.change: Require a CPA owner-evidence gate before any owner-labelled export, expose Florida's individual-only scope, and keep all current generic contact gates separate from ownership proof.

iterations.test: Focused synthetic regression checks in tests/lead-engine-industry-corrections.test.ts, lead-engine-reviews.test.ts, lead-engine-gates-jobs.test.ts and lead-engine-jobs.test.ts. No paid provider call.
iterations.observed: Export status no longer infers ownership or a home trace from recipe B. Current phone clearance and source-role identity remain distinct from independently supported ownership; the proposed owner-evidence pipeline is not yet wired.
iterations.change: Shared runtime correction integrated. Original source samples are retained with their original denominators; no phone-yield improvement is claimed.

measurement.result: Five local Florida CPA fixture rows: three eligible individual AC rows kept, one inactive AC row held, and one AD firm row omitted. Focused FL and IL adapter tests passed. Fixture/code audit only; no live source, phone, owner, handset, compliance, or delivery measurement.

cost.basis: Local five-row fixture/code audit only; no source fetch, provider, append, trace, review, or phone-verification call ran.
cost.note: No clean owner contact was measured. Historical brain benchmarks use a different denominator and do not establish clean-contact cost.

implementation.summary: Export status no longer infers ownership or a home trace from recipe B. Current phone clearance and source-role identity remain distinct from independently supported ownership; the proposed owner-evidence pipeline is not yet wired. Original review: CPA has implemented FL, IL, and PA register mappings, a Maps-delivery prohibition, and generic recipe-B contact gates. The runtime can deliver a recipe-B verified row without calling assessOwnerEvidence, so it does not implement owner-confirmed CPA delivery or direct owner-handset proof.

nextMeasurement: After wiring the owner-evidence gate, run a lawful 5–20 row aggregate public-business-contact study only from a catalog-verified endpoint. Separate active credentialed, business-matched, independent-owner-supported, published-business-contact, mobile, reachable, DNC/TCPA-clear, suppression/duplicate-clear, direct-owner-contact-supported, and delivered denominators; do not use residential/property sources to find unpublished personal phones or use DMV, South Carolina, or Utah forbidden sources.
